facts.fact: NimbaPay went live with three e-money institutions, three banks and one microfinance institution and two use cases, and processed over GNF 100 billion in its first four months.
NimbaPay in service links banks, e-money institutions and a microfinance institution, so payments pass between wallets and banks.
NimbaPay is described as Guinea's instant and inclusive payment system, operated by Guinéenne de Monétique for the BCRG, with a new wave of institutions expected by the end of December 2026.
